info.title: Nummo API
info.description: API de administración financiera y cartera (V1): auth multi-tenant, contactos, cartera con mora, pagos, gastos/egresos, caja y reportes. Autenticación por cookie de sesión (HttpOnly) + CSRF; dinero como string decimal.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Billing concepts, interest policies and agreements

tags.name: Finances
tags.description: Payment methods, accounts, transfers, balances and movements

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Dashboard aggregations: cashflow, cartera, payables, movements

tags.name: Assistant
tags.description: AI assistant configuration: providers, models and BYOK API keys

get.description: Liveness/readiness probe. Reports API status and DB connectivity.

200.description: Service is up (the `db` field reports database connectivity).

get.summary: Get a CSRF token (also set as a cookie)

post.summary: Log in and start a session (sets an HttpOnly cookie)

get.summary: List active sessions for the current user

post.summary: Revoke all other sessions (keep the current one)

201.description: Created organization with the caller as OWNER.

get.summary: List organizations the current user belongs to

post.summary: Apply the default master-data template for a vertical (OWNER/ADMIN, idempotent)
post.description: Seeds sensible billing concepts, expense categories, payment methods and accounts for the organization vertical. Skips items that already exist, so it is safe to call more than once. Body `type` overrides the stored organization type.

post.summary: Create a relationship from this contact to another
Generate due recurring receivables for this organization (OWNER/ADMIN/ACCOUNTANT)
Accrue late interest on overdue receivables now (OWNER/ADMIN/ACCOUNTANT)
post.description: Idempotent per receivable/day: charges only the delta versus interest already posted. Also runs daily in the worker.

get.summary: Get a receivable with its balance and adjustments
List the interest accruals posted on a receivable

post.description: Posts a WAIVER adjustment that reduces the balance without editing history. Capped at outstanding interest.

post.summary: Register a payment (movement + payment + allocations, one transaction)
post.description: Purpose RECEIVABLE may include allocations; ADVANCE leaves an unapplied credit; DIRECT_INCOME needs a concept. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

get.summary: Get a payment with allocations and unallocated amount

post.summary: Reverse a payment (REVERSAL movement + status REVERSED; no destructive edits)
Generate due recurring expenses for this organization (OWNER/ADMIN/ACCOUNTANT)

get.summary: Get an expense with its balance

post.summary: Register a disbursement (movement OUT + disbursement + allocations, one transaction)
post.description: Purpose EXPENSE may include allocations; ADVANCE leaves an unapplied credit; DIRECT_EXPENSE needs a category. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

get.summary: Get a disbursement with allocations and unallocated amount

post.summary: Reverse a disbursement (REVERSAL movement + status REVERSED; no destructive edits)

get.summary: List account balances (opening + IN − OUT, from v_financial_account_balances)

post.summary: Register an internal transfer (TRANSFER_OUT + TRANSFER_IN, one transaction)
post.description: Moves money between two accounts without changing total income/expense (OWNER/ADMIN/ACCOUNTANT).

get.summary: List the cash-movement ledger (paginated; filters by account/type/date)
Cashflow (income/expense/net) for a period + previous-period comparison
Monthly cashflow series (income/expense/net) for the last N months
Receivables totals (outstanding, overdue, counts by status)
Receivables outstanding balance bucketed by age (not due, 1–30, 31–60, 60+)
Payables outstanding balance bucketed by age (not due, 1–30, 31–60, 60+)
Receivables due within the next N days
Payables due within the next N days
Income grouped by billing concept for a period
Expenses grouped by category for a period
AI assistant settings: configured providers (masked), active provider and model catalog (OWNER/ADMIN)

put.summary: Set/replace the API key + model for a provider (OWNER/ADMIN)
put.description: Stores the provider API key encrypted at rest (never returned). `provider` is one of anthropic|openai|google|deepseek. The first provider configured becomes active automatically; pass `activate:true` to switch to another.

post.summary: Make a configured provider the active one (OWNER/ADMIN)
Enviar un mensaje al asistente Numi (cualquier miembro)
post.description: Envía un mensaje a Numi y recibe su respuesta. Devuelve `sessionId` para continuar la conversación (reenvíalo en las siguientes llamadas). Requiere que un administrador haya configurado un proveedor de IA activo.
